svg.title: Not My Will
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 4 panels. Panel 1 (Luke 22:41-42): at night on the Mount of Olives Jesus kneels alone, the sleeping disciples a stone's throw off. Caption: "The night before the cross, Jesus kneels and prays." Jesus says: "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me." Panel 2 (Matthew 26:42): Jesus kneels again alone, praying. Caption: "Again He prays the words He taught (Matthew 6:10):". Jesus says: "If this cannot pass unless I drink it, your will be done." Panel 3 (Luke 23:33, 46): three crosses on a rise under a darkened sky. Caption: "The cup is not taken away." Jesus says: "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" Panel 4 (Hebrews 5:7; Luke 24:5-6): the tomb open at dawn, its stone rolled back. Caption: "“He was heard because of his reverence.” (Hebrews 5:7)". The two men at the tomb says: "He is not here, but has risen." Note: "Heard: read here, with the ESV Study Bible, as the resurrection." The point: Jesus prayed “your will be done,” and His Father heard Him. So you can pray it too, and leave the answer with Him (Matthew 26:42; Hebrews 5:7).
svg.text: Jesus prays the words He taught

g.text: Heard: read here, with the ESV
